## Mutation-Fuzzing Optimization

All seeds maintain mutation-optimized architecture:

### Three-Zone Structure
- **Declaration Zone**: 8-12 amplification variables per seed
- **Setup Zone**: Resource creation with line repetition (Transform feedback + texture setup)
- **Execution Zone**: TF begin/end + draws + layer/slice iteration

### Variable Tiers
- **Tier 1**: 8-12 amplification variables (layer counts, slice indices, TF buffer sizes)
- **Tier 2**: 20-40 inline literals (texture dimensions, format enums)
- **Tier 3**: 6-8 enum constants (TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, TEXTURE_3D, TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK)

### Line Repetition Patterns
- Layer/slice iteration loops (128-256 iterations)
- Transform feedback begin/end cycling
- Texture array layer binding
- 3D texture slice updates
- Query polling spam

### Error Path Exploitation
- 12-18 try-catch blocks per seed
- Transform feedback state errors (begin without end, double begin)
- Texture array layer out-of-bounds
- 3D texture coordinate errors
- Format mismatch between TF and texture

## Technical Notes

### Transform Feedback Patterns

**Core TF Setup**:
```javascript
const varyings = ['position', 'color', 'layerIndex'];
gl.transformFeedbackVaryings(program, varyings, gl.INTERLEAVED_MODE);
gl.linkProgram(program);

const tfBuffer = gl.createBuffer();
gl.bindBuffer(gl.TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER, tfBuffer);
gl.bufferData(gl.TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER, bufferSize, gl.DYNAMIC_COPY);

gl.bindTransformFeedback(gl.TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK, tf);
gl.bindBufferBase(gl.TRANSFORM_FEEDBACK_BUFFER, 0, tfBuffer);

gl.beginTransformFeedback(gl.TRIANGLES);
gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, vertexCount);
gl.endTransformFeedback();
```

**Texture Array Integration**:
```javascript
const texArray = gl.createTexture();
gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, texArray);
gl.texStorage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, 1, gl.RGBA8, 256, 256, 128);

// Write TF output to texture array layers
for (let layer = 0; layer < 128; layer++) {
    gl.texSubImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY, 0, 0, 0, layer,
                     256, 256, 1, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, tfData);
}
```

**3D Texture Integration**:
```javascript
const tex3D = gl.createTexture();
gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tex3D);
gl.texStorage3D(gl.TEXTURE_3D, 1, gl.RGBA8, 128, 128, 128);

// Write TF output to 3D texture slices
for (let slice = 0; slice < 128; slice++) {
    gl.texSubImage3D(gl.TEXTURE_3D, 0, 0, 0, slice,
                     128, 128, 1, gl.RGBA, gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE, tfData);
}
```

- Batch 46: 13-17 try-catch blocks, 200-260 lines
